statement: Intervals shorter than an hour that cross midnight have zero complete hours in either direction.
assume: startTick >= 0 && startTick <= 191 && endTick >= 0 && endTick <= 191 && startTick >= 93 && startTick <= 98 && endTick >= 93 && endTick <= 98 && ((startTick < 96 && endTick >= 96) || (endTick < 96 && startTick >= 96)) && endTick - startTick > -4 && endTick - startTick < 4

adapter.mapping: Independent ticks 0 through 191 denote quarter-hours from 2012-06-15 00:00, local civil time on June 15 and 16. The unit is ChronoUnit.HOURS. No zone conversion.
